title: Activation Recovery, Inventory Isolation & Persistent Snapshot Catalog Repair Matrix (B01–B28)

B01.description: Candidate DB verification via isolated worker thread offload without blocking Host event loop

B04.description: Zero whole-file buffers in Host thread during candidate verification and custom startup recovery

B07.description: Strict UUID-to-filename binding check (databaseFile === custom-${snapshotId}.sqlite3) enforced

B13.description: Crash consistency & intent recovery: startup recovery with Custom active and unconfirmed settings sync recovers Custom

B14.description: Crash consistency & intent recovery: startup recovery with Managed active and unconfirmed settings sync recovers Managed

B20.description: Catalog corrupt safe degradation: corrupted custom-snapshots/index.json degrades safely without throwing

B22.description: Active lease protection: snapshot in active use cannot be deleted via cleanupSnapshot

B28.description: Unified concurrency mutex across install, remove, activate-custom, and select-mode operations
